info.name: MasterData - NEC Middleware
info.description:
Postman collection for Master Data Management APIs in NEC Middleware. Covers Regions, Districts, Cities, Polling Stations, Voter Registration Centers, Universities, Warehouses, Warehouse Sub Stores, Political Parties, Bank Accounts, Deployment Roles, and HR Trainer TOT.

All save endpoints handle both CREATE (id=null) and UPDATE (id=non-null).
Status values are case-sensitive: 'active'/'inactive' for Regions; 'Active'/'Inactive' for all others.

request.description:
Creates a new region. Omit 'id' or set to null for creation.

Required: regionName (max 150), status ('active' or 'inactive')
Optional: createdBy

Updates an existing region. Provide 'id' to update.

Required: id, regionName, status
Optional: updatedBy
Returns a full list of all regions (no pagination).
Fetches a single region by its numeric ID.

Creates a new district linked to a region.

Required: regionId, districtName (max 150), status ('Active' or 'Inactive')
Optional: createdBy
Updates an existing district.

Returns a paginated list of districts.

Optional query params:
- regionId: Filter by region
- districtName: Filter by name
- page: 0-indexed (default 0)
- size: 1–100 (default 20)
Fetches a single district by its numeric ID.

Creates a new city linked to a region and district.

Required: regionId, districtId, cityName (max 150), status ('Active' or 'Inactive')
Optional: createdBy
Updates an existing city.

Returns a paginated list of cities.

Optional filters: regionId, districtId
Pagination: page (default 0), size (default 20, max 100)
Fetches a single city by its numeric ID.
